hook: He knows what your heart whispers.

segments.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ
segments.en: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him,

segments.ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
segments.en: and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
